title: Ringed-topos pullback preserves flat-term K-flat complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal C'$ be small sites, let $\mathcal O,\mathcal O'$ be sheaves of commutative rings, and let $u:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C')\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ be a morphism of topoi, meaning an adjoint pair $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ with $u^{-1}$ preserving finite limits. Let $c:u^{-1}\mathcal O\to\mathcal O'$ be a homomorphism of sheaves of rings. Define $u^*F=u^{-1}F\otimes_{u^{-1}\mathcal O}\mathcal O'$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and apply this functor termwise to cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. If $K^\bullet$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex] and all its terms are flat $\mathcal O$-module sheaves [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], then $u^*K^\bullet$ is K-flat over $\mathcal O'$ and all its terms are flat $\mathcal O'$-module sheaves.

proof.text: Choose q:L to P with L flat termwise and K-flat, q a quasi-isomorphism, and uStar(L) K-flat, using [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-pullback-adapted-flat-resolution]. This step does not use K-flatness of P.

Tensoring preserves colimits and hence is additive in each variable by [lem-weil-pbc-independent-sheaf-tensor-colimits]. Mathlib mapBifunctorMappingCone₂Iso identifies tensor(A,Cone q) with the cone of the tensor map. The triangulated subcategory of acyclic complexes gives cone two-out-of-three. Consequently Cone q is K-flat when L and P are K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex]. The proof implements this comparison and both needed directions of two-out-of-three.

The cone of a quasi-isomorphism is acyclic by CochainComplex.mappingCone.quasiIso_iff_acyclic. A cone term is the biproduct L^(n+1) plus P^n. Flatness [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules] is invariant under isomorphism and finite biproducts: the explicit site tensor functor is naturally isomorphic to localized tensorRight, and the latter on a biproduct is the finite colimit of its two exact summands. This proves that every cone term is flat.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-acyclic-kflat-pullback] to the acyclic, K-flat, flat-term cone. Additive functors commute with mapping cones by Mathlib mappingCone.mapHomologicalComplexIso. Thus the cone of uStar(q) is K-flat. Cone two-out-of-three with uStar(L) proves that uStar(P) is K-flat.

For each term, apply [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-flat-module-pullback]. The given AlgebraicInverseImage is converted to the equal-coefficient AlgebraicInverseImageOfUniverses using the natural ULift-trivial isomorphisms; all its graph compatibility fields follow from those of I. At equal coefficient and module universes, changeOfRings and changeOfRingsOfUniverses agree definitionally. This yields flatness of every image term.

lean.statement:
theorem isKFlat_ringedToposPullback
    {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD} [Category.{vC} C] [Category.{vD} D]
    [EssentiallySmall.{w} C] [EssentiallySmall.{w} D]
    {JC : GrothendieckTopology C} {JD : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {R : Sheaf JC CommRingCat.{w}} {S RI : Sheaf JD CommRingCat.{w}}
    (uInv : Sheaf JC (Type (w)) ⥤ Sheaf JD (Type (w)))
    (uPush : Sheaf JD (Type (w)) ⥤ Sheaf JC (Type (w)))
    (adj : uInv ⊣ uPush) [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (I : AlgebraicInverseImage uInv R RI) (c : RI ⟶ S)
    (uStar : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R) ⥤
      ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JD
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj S))
    (hobj : ∀ M : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R),
      uStar.obj M = changeOfRings c (I.modules.obj M))
    (hmap : ∀ {M N : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)} (a : M ⟶ N),
      uStar.map a = eqToHom (hobj M) ≫
        changeOfRingsHom c (I.modules.obj M) (I.modules.map a) ≫ eqToHom (hobj N).symm)
    [uStar.Additive]
    (P : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) (hflat : ∀ n : ℤ, IsFlatOnSite (J := JC) (R := R) (P.X n)) :
    CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat ((uStar.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P) ∧
      ∀ n : ℤ, IsFlatOnSite (J := JD) (R := S)
        (((uStar.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P).X n)
